name: Roman Egg Drop Soup (Stracciatella) with Olive, Tomato & Avocado Salad
ingredients: 64 fl oz chicken or vegetable broth
instructions: Wash and dry the fresh produce. (Skip the spinach if it came pre-washed.)
Mince olives and sun-dried tomatoes; transfer both to a small bowl along with oil, vinegar, salt, and pepper. Stir to combine the tapenade and set aside.
Pour broth into a large pot, add spices, and bring to a boil over medium heat. Once boiling, reduce to a simmer.
Meanwhile, pick basil leaves off the stems, roll up crosswise, and thinly slice into ribbons; transfer to a medium bowl.
Finely grate Parmesan; add to the bowl with the basil (setting a small handful aside for garnish).
Add eggs to the bowl and whisk until well blended; set aside.
Add spinach to the simmering broth in handfuls, waiting for the spinach to wilt slightly before adding the next handful.
Slowly pour the egg mixture into the soup, while gently stirring, to separate into ribbons. Simmer until the egg is cooked through, 2-3 minutes; cover and remove from heat.
Meanwhile, halve and pit the avocados. Slice thinly while still in skin and scoop out with a spoon. Thinly slice tomatoes.
Arrange avocado and tomato slices on plates and spoon tapenade over top.
Divide soup between bowls and top with reserved Parmesan. Serve with salad on the side and enjoy!
author: Mealime
